channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Melania: Is $75m movie about President Trump’s wife a Box Office flop?
item.description: It cost $75m to make and the director was accused of sexual misconduct and harassment by a series of women a decade ago.

item.title: How do people in China view Donald Trump?
item.description: We spoke to Shen Dingli, a professor of international affairs in Shanghai.

item.title: Iain Duncan Smith: Starmer negotiated ‘bad deal’ over China MP sanctions
item.description: Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer has said China agreed to lift sanctions against six British MPs and peers after his talks with the Chinese leader Xi Jinping, insisting he had been able to raise "difficult issues" during their meeting.

item.title: Epstein files: new photos show Andrew crouched over female
item.description: Andrew Mountbatten Windsor has yet again become embroiled in the Epstein scandal: as a trawl through millions of newly released files uncovered photographs, email exchanges and even an invitation to Buckingham Palace shortly after Epstein was released from house arrest in 2010.

item.title: ‘Confident Epstein and Maxwell are not the only sexual abusers’, says survivors’ lawyer
item.description: We spoke to Gloria Allred - who's represented some of Epstein's victims.

item.title: Starmer invites Japan PM to UK after Tokyo talks
item.description: Sir Keir Starmer has declared that relations between Britain and Japan are the strongest they've been for decades - as he invited the Japanese Prime Minister to visit the UK. Our political editor Gary Gibbon has been traveling with the Prime Minister.

item.title: Gaza: Israeli strikes kill at least 30, hospital officials say
item.description: Hospital officials in Gaza say at least 30 people have been killed in a wave of Israeli airstrikes across the territory. Israel said it had targeted Hamas and Islamic Jihad commanders - claiming they had violated the ceasefire. Gaza officials said at least 6 children were among the dead.

item.title: Over 200 killed in mine collapse in eastern Congo
item.description: At least 200 people are said to have been killed in eastern Congo - after a landslide earlier this week caused several mines to collapse. Officials said some people could still be trapped in the debris at the site in Rubaya - which lies in an area controlled by M23 rebels.

item.title: Atlantic current collapse could trigger ‘unprecedented’ cooling, scientists warn
item.description: Dozens of scientists from 15 countries have warned that climate change is putting one of the earth's most important ocean currents in danger of collapse.

item.title: Glasgow’s Celtic Connections festival unites Irish and Iraqi musicians
item.description: Every January thousands of music lovers from around the world are drawn to Glasgow for the Celtic Connections festival.
